#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long modPow(long long a, long long e, long long mod) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    long long N, M;
    int K;
    cin >> N >> M >> K;
    long long invM = modPow(M, MOD - 2, MOD);
    long long mod = invM;
    vector<long long> expect(K + 1);
    vector<long long> poly(K + 1);
    expect[0] = 1;
    poly[0] = 1;
    long long curExpect = 1;
    for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
        curExpect = (curExpect * (N - (k - 1))) % MOD;
        curExpect = (curExpect * mod) % MOD;
        for (int i = k; i >= 0; i--) {
            long long old_poly_i = poly[i];
            poly[i] = (i > 0 ? poly[i - 1] : 0) + (-(k - 1)) * old_poly_i;
            poly[i] = (poly[i] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        expect[k] = curExpect;
        for (int i = k - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            long long prod = (poly[i] * expect[i]) % MOD;
            expect[k] = (expect[k] - prod) % MOD;
            expect[k] = (expect[k] + MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }
    cout << expect[K] << endl;
    return 0;
}
